request: In rdn (root domain) scope mode, a host is in scope only when it is the root domain itself or a subdomain of it at a label boundary (sub.example.com for example.com). A look-alike host that merely ends with the same characters, such as notexample.com or evilexample.com, is out of scope.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix: require label boundary for rdn scope to block look-alike domains (#1685)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > pkg/utils/scope/scope_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestManagerValidate)$' ./pkg/utils/scope >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
